name: Robert Hidri
title: IoT Engineer
tagline: I build connected systems — from carbon footprint calculators to sensor networks. Problem solver who explains complex tech through stories and analogies.

about.heading: Engineer who explains, builds, and solves
paragraphs: I'm an IoT engineer with a talent for explaining complex technical topics through stories and analogies. I lead understanding through structured thinking, and I'm an experimental problem solver who creates and tests ideas quickly.

At Genelec OY, I started in logistics automation planning, then transitioned to the R&D team where I designed and built a carbon footprint calculator — a Python-based tool that calculates CO₂e emissions for individual products based on real production data. This became my thesis (grade: 4/5).

I thrive under constraints — they sharpen my creativity for finding elegant solutions. Whether designing embedded systems or software architecture, I think in modules, interfaces, and connections. This portfolio itself demonstrates that: a plugin architecture where data is separate from presentation.
